topic: Active vs passive funds, explained simply

slides.headline: Which fund style fits your plan?
slides.subhead: One picks stocks, one tracks the index. Both have a role.

points.title: Active funds
points.text: A manager selects stocks, trying to match or outperform an index.

points.title: Passive funds
points.text: Follow an index like Sensex or Nifty, holding all or most stocks in it.

points.title: Your choice
points.text: Consider costs, your belief in active management, and your time horizon.

slides.headline: Learn more at your pace
slides.cta: Save this for your next fund review

caption: Active funds employ a manager to pick stocks; passive funds replicate an index. Both serve long-term investors with different philosophies. Neither approach is inherently superior, and costs matter. Choose what aligns with your belief and goals. #FundBasics #ActiveVsPassive #MutualFundEducation #InvestingSimplified #YourChoice
